messages:
maria: FYI - after the role-matrix PR merged last night I can see an 'Export API Key' button as a viewer on a couple of customer accounts. Not sure if it's just UI or a real access leak.

anika: can you repro? steps + env?

maria: repro steps: login as test-viewer@acme -> Project > Settings > API Keys -> Export button visible next to key. clicking shows modal then backend 403. so backend denies, but button shouldn't be visible.

jake: which PR? the consolidate-role-sync change (PR #4237) touched the client permission mapping.

samir: can reproduce on prod-stable for one account. grabbing console/network logs now.

security-bot: audit-log: {"ts":"2026-03-21T02:12:05Z","service":"console","user":"test-viewer@acme","action":"view_api_keys","result":"403"} :eyes:

leo: quick KMS check: no decrypt/unseal events for customer-key-1234 since 2026-03-21T00:00Z. so far looks like affordance-only leak. (checked KMS audit console)

maria: good. still, showing the button leaks existence of keys and could be social-engineering risk. need hotfix to hide.

anika: assigning to frontend to flip gating ASAP. timeline? can we push a toggle to prod in 30m? cc @elaine for compliance heads-up.

jake: root cause snippet:
```js
// before (correct)
if (user.hasPermission('export_keys')) { showExport(); }

// after PR (bug)
if (user.role === 'viewer') { showExport(); } // oops - logic inverted during refactor
```

samir: that explains it. frontend is relying on role enum instead of permission bit. backend still enforces export permission so no 200s yet.

anika: i'll open a rollback PR to revert the client mapping and add a unit test. also pushing a quick feature-flag to hide the whole keys panel for viewers until fixed.

ops-bot: deploy-triggered: canary deploy started for frontend/hotfix-5087 -> servers: fe-01, fe-02

maria: security request: please add a short-lived audit sampling to catch any 200s for export_key action and alert on any positive results.

security-bot: added detection rule: sample export_key actions for next 1h; alert channel #incidents if result==200. incident id P0-UI-LEAK-20260321 created.

elaine: product/compliance notified. capturing notes for customer comms if needed. keep me posted on timeline and whether any data egress occurred.

jake: PR: #4249 open with fix, unit tests added, gating corrected to use hasPermission('export_keys'). trying for hot-patch.

ops-bot: deploy-success: frontend/hotfix-5087 -> prod rolled on fe-01..fe-04 (4/4) at 2026-03-21T02:45:12Z

samir: verified in prod: button hidden for viewer role in the UI; attempted export returns 403 as before. no 200s observed in the sampled audit logs.

leo: KMS audit final check: still no decrypt operations tied to those viewer accounts. attaching sample:
`KMS: 2026-03-21T02:46:07Z service=cloudkms action=GetPublicKey resource=projects/x/keys/customer-key-1234 status=200 caller=console-service`

maria: great. action items: 1) ship PR #4249 revert mapping (anika/jake) 2) add end-to-end test for permission gating (jake) 3) add UI e2e that runs with least-privilege accounts (anika) 4) postmortem + notify affected customers if audit shows any 200s (maria/elaine).

anika: on it. i'll follow up with a short postmortem doc and link here when ready.

security-bot: incident P0-UI-LEAK-20260321 status -> mitigated. monitoring for 2h.

maria: thanks all. good catch and quick turn. we'll keep the monitoring window open and reconvene if anything pops up. :thumbsup:
